== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Hoth: Echo Med Lab (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Hoth: Echo Med Lab]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100687 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100687], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100687-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>c41877100aaa5555aa535055d27c94c5eb4b6268eb11a579ba11d3ce4babcaeb</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
